fields.name: image_size
fields.title: Image Size
fields.description: The size of the generated image. Custom dimensions within the provider's pixel and aspect limits are sent unchanged. Other sizes use compatible scaling. The provider's native pixel range is 2560x1440 to 4096x4096, with aspect ratio between 1/16 and 16.

fields.name: output_format
fields.title: Output Format
fields.description: The file format of the generated images.

fields.name: watermark
fields.title: Watermark
fields.description: Whether to add the provider's visible watermark.

fields.name: sequential_image_generation
fields.title: Sequential Image Generation
fields.description: Generate related images with `auto`, or one image per generation with `disabled`. When omitted, values of `max_images` above one enable `auto`.
